text: Вы только вдумайтесь. Прошли миллионы лет эволюции, а женщины так и не научились получать оргазм за полторы минуты.

variants.title: Intelligent Cynic
variants.prompt:
Speak in a distinctive male voice around 35 years old. Use a warm, rich, medium-low tone with exceptionally clear diction.

Sound intelligent, calm, highly self-confident and subtly cynical. There should be a quiet sense of superiority and private amusement, as if you understand human behavior very well and find it slightly ridiculous.

Speak naturally and conversationally, as if talking privately to one person sitting across from you.

Absolutely avoid the sound of a professional announcer, radio host, audiobook narrator, commercial voice-over, presenter, actor performing a character, or AI assistant.

Use dry, understated humor. Never perform the joke or signal that a punchline is coming. Deliver the funniest and most provocative part with complete seriousness.

Keep the delivery relaxed, effortless, intelligent and subtly ironic. Every word must remain immediately understandable.

variants.title: Deadpan Dark Humor
variants.prompt:
Speak in a calm, highly intelligible male voice around 35–40 years old. Use a natural medium-low pitch.

Sound extremely composed, intelligent, observant and cynical, as if almost nothing in human behavior can surprise you anymore.

Use very dry, deadpan humor. Do not sound amused before the punchline and never announce through your intonation that something funny is coming.

The more absurd, provocative or inappropriate the statement becomes, the calmer and more matter-of-fact your delivery should become.

Use subtle natural pauses, especially immediately before an unexpected conclusion.

Speak as though everything you are saying is perfectly reasonable and obvious.

Avoid announcer, presenter, theatrical, commercial, audiobook and AI-assistant delivery.

The overall effect should be calm, sophisticated, cynical, slightly dark and unexpectedly funny, while maintaining exceptionally clear diction.

variants.title: Charming Rogue
variants.prompt:
Speak in a charismatic male voice around 30–35 years old. Use a warm, confident, medium-low tone with exceptionally clear diction.

Sound intelligent, charming, slightly arrogant, playfully shameless and naturally self-confident.

There should be subtle sexual confidence in the voice, but never sound macho, vulgar, sleazy or exaggerated.

Speak casually, as if talking to someone you know very well. Let there be a subtle mischievous smile hidden in the voice.

Use a lively but natural conversational rhythm with small changes in pace.

Never sound like an announcer, radio host, commercial voice-over, audiobook narrator, presenter, actor performing a role, or AI assistant.

Do not try to make the listener laugh. Speak as if provocative observations about sex, relationships, money and human weaknesses are simply normal things to discuss.

The overall effect should be intelligent, charming, mischievous, confident and slightly dangerous.

variants.title: Natural Roughness
variants.prompt:
Speak in a distinctive male voice around 35–40 years old. Use a warm, medium-low tone with subtle natural texture and a very slight roughness.

The voice should feel lived-in, human and naturally imperfect rather than polished, sterile or studio-perfect.

Add only a hint of natural raspiness. Never make the voice heavily raspy, hoarse or difficult to understand.

Maintain exceptionally clear diction and effortless intelligibility.

Sound calm, experienced, intelligent, self-confident and slightly cynical.

Speak conversationally and naturally, without theatrical acting or exaggerated emotion.

Avoid narrator, announcer, radio presenter, advertisement, audiobook, professional voice-over and AI-assistant delivery.

The result should feel masculine, warm, authentic, slightly imperfect and memorable — a voice that remains pleasant even after listening to it every day.

variants.title: Young Smart Ass
variants.prompt:
Speak in a distinctive male voice around 27–30 years old. Use a natural medium pitch with extremely clear diction.

Sound young, clever, quick-witted, confident, energetic, slightly cocky and naturally sarcastic.

Speak somewhat faster than average, while keeping every word perfectly understandable.

There should be youthful energy and spontaneity, but never sound childish, cartoonish, hyperactive or artificially enthusiastic.

Deliver provocative humor casually, with the attitude of someone who knows exactly what he is saying and is quietly enjoying how inappropriate it might be.

Do not perform the joke.

Avoid announcer, presenter, actor, commercial, audiobook, radio-host and AI-assistant delivery.

The overall impression should be modern, witty, spontaneous, cheeky, confident and slightly rebellious.

variants.title: Intimate / Confidential
variants.prompt:
Speak in a warm, intimate male voice around 35 years old. Use a soft, medium-low tone with exceptionally clear diction.

Imagine the listener is sitting very close to you and you are speaking only to that one person, not to an audience.

Speak slightly more quietly than normal conversation while keeping every word perfectly understandable.

Sound intelligent, confident, relaxed, subtly cynical and personally engaged with the listener.

Use small natural pauses. Occasionally lower the voice slightly, as if sharing a private observation that perhaps should not be said too loudly.

Do not whisper and do not use exaggerated ASMR delivery.

Avoid announcer, presenter, commercial, audiobook, theatrical, professional voice-over and AI-assistant delivery.

The result should feel private, magnetic, confidential, slightly provocative and unusually pleasant to listen to.

variants.title: Unpredictable Charisma
variants.prompt:
Speak in a distinctive, charismatic male voice around 32–38 years old. Use a warm, medium-low tone with exceptionally clear diction.

Sound intelligent, confident, cynical, relaxed and slightly mischievous.

Use a natural but subtly unpredictable conversational rhythm. Do not maintain the same speed, pitch or intensity throughout the sentence.

Occasionally move through an unimportant phrase a little faster, then slow down around an important word. Use brief, unexpected but natural pauses.

Sometimes make an important word more noticeable by becoming slightly quieter or slower rather than louder.

The rhythm should feel spontaneous and human, never random, theatrical or exaggerated.

Never sacrifice intelligibility.

Avoid polished announcer rhythm, presenter cadence, audiobook narration, advertising delivery, professional voice-over and AI-assistant intonation.

The result should feel alive, charismatic and distinctive — a person whose way of speaking gradually becomes recognizable even without seeing his face.
